title: Act 170 statutory district groupings
description: The groupings named in Act 170 as first-class registry objects: each is a named set of district slugs. These become the default scenarios in the modeling tool. Every grouping's membership is hand-entered from the act text and carries a citation, because no API publishes them.

section_reference.description: Where in the act the groupings are set out.

status.description: `verified` means every grouping's membership has been read off the act text by a human. Until then the tool must not present these as authoritative.

groupings.description: Empty is a valid and honest state. It means the act text has not been transcribed yet -- which is very different from the act containing no groupings.

number.description: The grouping's number as given in the act. Drives the /groupings/<n>/ URL.

members.description: Slugs of the districts the act places in this grouping.

member_names_as_written.description: District names exactly as the act writes them, before mapping to registry slugs. Kept so the mapping itself is auditable -- act names and AOE names do not always agree.

verified.description: True only when a human has read this grouping's membership off the act text.

unmapped_members.description: Names in the act that could not be matched to a registry entity. Surfaced rather than dropped -- a silently dropped district is a wrong scenario.
